author: Sara Tracey
title: Libraries, street fair hosting used book sales in coming days - NewsBreak
text:
By Sara Tracey ,
12 hours ago Signs direct visitors to the used book sale at the Upper Madison Street Fair on Oct. 4, 2021. This year's fair is from 12 to 5 p.m. Sunday, Sept. 28, on Madison Avenue in Albany between Allen and West Lawrence Streets. (Courtesy of the Upper Madison Street Fair) If you’re in the market for a new-to-you book, several libraries and a weekend street fair are hosting used book sales in the coming weeks. Many of those put on by the libraries are organized by their respective Friends of the Library groups.
Most items at these sales are $1 or less, with opportunities for steeper discounts on specific days.

Bethlehem Where: Bethlehem Public Library, 451 Delaware Ave., Delmar
Saturday, 10 a.m.-4:30 p.m. More info: friendsofbethpl.org/
Colonie Where: William K. Sanford Town Library, 629 Albany Shaker Road, Colonie
Thursday, 4-7 p.m. (Preview night: $5 cash entrance fee) Friday, 10 a.m.-5 p.m. Saturday, 10 a.m.-4 p.m. Sunday, 1-4 p.m. ($5 bag sale) More info: colonielibrary.org
Clifton Park-Halfmoon Where: 475 Moe Road, Clifton Park
Friday, 11:45 a.m.-12:45 p.m. (Preview for Friends of the Library Members) Friday, 1-5 p.m. Saturday, 10 a.m.-4 p.m. Sunday, 12:15-4 p.m. (Dime Day: all books are 10 cents each) More info: friendsofcphlibrary.org
Schenectady Where: Hon. Karen B. Johnson Main Library, 99 Clinton St., Schenectady
Saturday: 10 a.m.-4 p.m. Sunday: 12-3 p.m. (Bag sale: fill a bag — provided by cashier — for $4) More info: friendsofscpl.org/book-sales
Upper Madison Street Fair While not a library, the free weekend festival plays host to a $1 book sale. The proceeds benefit the Upper Madison Group's projects to promote and beautify the neighborhood.
Where: Madison Avenue between Allen and West Lawrence streets; the sale will be held under a large tented area
Sunday, 12-5 p.m. More info: uppermadison.org/streetfair
East Greenbush Where: 10 Community Way, East Greenbush
Friday, Oct. 10, 9 a.m.-5 p.m. Saturday, Oct. 11, 9 a.m.-4 p.m. Sunday, Oct. 12, 11 a.m.-2:30 p.m. (Bag sale: $5 per bring-your-own bag) More info: eglibrary.org/friends/book-sale
